# 02 — Metrics & the Metrics Gym

The numbers every space is built around. They're consistent with the game bible (21 — 3Cs, 22 — Balance) and the parts bible's building grid (2.5 m large-grid cell), so authored spaces and player-built bases fit together.

![Metrics Gym generated by the Blender level toolkit](images/metrics-gym.jpg)

*The Metrics Gym, generated by `exodus_levels.py gym` from the tables below.*

| Step height | **0.45 m** | Higher needs a mantle |
| Max walkable slope | **45°** | Steeper slides; 50° test ramp in the gym |
| Standing jump height | **0.6 m** | Clears low debris only |
| Sprint-jump gap | **3.0 m (1 g)** | Scales with gravity: 5.5 m on the Moon |
| Vault (low mantle) | **≤ 1.0 m** | Waist-high obstacles, fences |
| High mantle | **1.0–2.0 m** | Above 2.0 m needs ladders, stairs or a jetpack |

## Navigation agents

| Agent | Radius | Height | Max step | Max slope | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Humanoid** | 0.35 m | 1.8 m | 0.45 m | 45° | Player, survivors, Shamblers, Runners, units |

| **Brute** | 0.9 m | 2.6 m | 0.6 m | 35° | Brutes, Burrowers above ground |
| **Giant** | 1.2 m | 3.2 m | 0.8 m | 35° | Sower Wardens, Seraph exo-frame |
| **Tessari** | 2.0 m | 4.9 m | 0.8 m | 30° | Tessari adults; large grazer kits |
| **Small animal** | 0.3 m | 0.6 m | 0.25 m | 50° | Dogs, coyotes, jackrabbits |

Every level bakes navmeshes for the agents that can reach it; doors, ducts and bridges are sized so the intended agents fit and the excluded ones don't (Brutes can't use 1.2 m doors; Crawlers can use ducts).
